gallery.alt: Tight crop of a rebuilt alternator resting on a grey mat, ribbed drive pulley and cast casing vents filling the frame
Black Audi A6 raised on a jack beneath a blue pop-up canopy with the rear wheel off and the brake disc bare, trunk open and tools laid out on the gravel
Maroon Nissan Altima lifted on a floor jack in a wet forecourt beside the open bed of the service truck, socket cases and fluids set out ready
Champagne Chevrolet Malibu with the hood up and the front bumper cover pulled away, radiator support and headlight housings exposed on a gravel driveway
Open engine bay of a Nissan V6 minivan with the air box lifted out, transmission housing and brake fluid reservoir exposed in daylight
Taped wiring harness and grey connectors hanging beside a serpentine belt pulley in a road-dusted engine bay
Dark Maserati Ghibli nosed in under a white work canopy with the hood raised and a padded cover draped over the front corner, the engine bay fully open
Replacement starter motor bolted to the bellhousing with its wiring plug clipped on, photographed from underneath the vehicle
New brake rotor slid onto the wheel studs with the grey caliper bracket resting alongside and the mechanic’s forearm steadying it

reviews.author: Hope
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Anthony. He came out the same day I called to look at my car, gave me a very fair price, and came back the next day exactly as promised to do the job. He was friendly, knowledgeable, and professional. It’s hard to find someone reliable and honest, and he definitely was both. He also took the time to talk with my son about helping him get his car back on the road, which I really appreciated. I highly recommend him and will definitely call him again in the future.

reviews.author: Richard Narvaez
reviews.text: I brought my Jeep in with an oil leak coming from the oil filter housing. The mechanic diagnosed the issue quickly and had it completely repaired the same day. Highly recommend for efficient, honest service.
